(Japanese: '''サトシ対ダンデ！最強への道！！''' ''{{tt|Satoshi|Ash}} VS {{tt|Dande|Leon}}! The Road to the Strongest!!'') is the fifth chapter of the {{ma|Pokémon Journeys}} manga. It is based on the [[JN013|animated series episode by the same name]]. ==Plot== {{Incomplete plot}} ==Major events== * [[Ash's Pikachu]] is revealed to be able to [[Gigantamax]]. * {{Ash}} and [[Goh]] properly meet {{an|Leon}} for the first time. * The Gigantamax {{OBP|Drednaw|recurring}} is defeated and returned to normal. * Ash learns about the [[World Coronation Series]] ranking system. * Ash receives a [[Dynamax Band]] from Leon. * Ash has an unofficial {{pkmn|battle}} with Leon and loses. * Ash decides to challenge the World Coronation Series to one day have an official battle with Leon. ===Debuts=== ====Humans==== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{Ash}} * [[Goh]] * {{an|Leon}} * [[Gym guide|Dan]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Pikachu}} ({{OP|Ash|Pikachu}}; [[Gigantamax]]) * {{p|Scorbunny}} ({{OP|Goh|Scorbunny}}) * {{p|Charizard}} ({{OP|Leon|Charizard}}; [[Gigantamax]]) * {{p|Drednaw}} ({{OBP|Drednaw|recurring|anime}}; [[Gigantamax]]) ==Differences between the animated series and the manga== * [[Team Rocket]]'s involvement with Drednaw and the wild {{DL|Rocket Prize Master|Chewtle}} are removed. * [[Gym guide|Dan]] debuts here, as his appearance in ''[[JN012|Flash of the Titans!]]'' was omitted in ''[[JNM04|Flash of the Titans!]]''. * [[Goh]] catching his {{TP|Goh|Skwovet}} is omitted. {{stub|Manga}} {{MangaPrevNext |prevcode=JNM04 |prevtitle=Flash of the Titans! |nextcode=JNM06 |nexttitle=Kicking It from Here into Tomorrow! |series=Pokémon Journeys |colorscheme=Galar}} [[es:PV005]] [[it:JNM05]]
